purpose: Frozen pseudo-operational replay with exact archived ECMWF runs, no future target observations in forcing, and parameters selected only from calibration events.
cutoff_rule: first 00 UTC ECMWF run after 24 h of observed event history; decision time fixed at run initialization + 6 h

boundary_policy.primary_rain_after_t0: same exact archived ECMWF IFS run used by the downstream replay
boundary_policy.primary_state_correction: observed 86472000 discharge available at/before t0 only; additive error decays with frozen tau=24 h
boundary_policy.optional_eligibility_at_t0: at least 18 distinct observed-flow hours in the 24 h ending at t0
boundary_policy.optional_future_after_t0: last observed discharge persisted; no future observed discharge enters HEC forcing
boundary_policy.fallback_primary_if_predictive_86472000_: 86510000 Muçum only when causally available; upstream topology is removed to prevent double counting

rain_policy.after_t0: one explicit archived ECMWF IFS run from Open-Meteo Single Runs API

no_leakage_rules: E27_MAY2024 and E28_JUN2024 never enter calibration parameter selection
E2026_JUL never enters calibration or validation tuning
the predictive 86472000 boundary is calibrated only on E22_SEP2023 and E24_NOV2023
future observed rainfall after t0 is verification-only and is not used as forcing
future observed discharge after t0 is verification-only and is not used as a Source hydrograph or state correction
all verification metrics are computed only at or after t0

verification_policy.flow_magnitude: WAPE/RMSE only where observed discharge is available
verification_policy.persistence_skill: computed only on identical station-time pairs with a valid observed discharge at t0
verification_policy.late_starting_observations: HEC is still scored after observations become available; they are not discarded merely because persistence is unavailable at t0
verification_policy.high_flow_rating_curve_guard: observed level is used independently for peak timing and rise/fall shape; no high-flow rating-curve extrapolation is invented
